text.description_html:
Schlage J-BRW, Dexter Series Broadway with Round Rose Lever Lockset

The Broadway with Round Rose Leverset was designed with an easy installation in mind. It has an adjustable latch that will fit 2-3/8 inch or 2-3/4 inch backsets and it will fit standard door thicknesses from 1-3/8 inches up to 1-3/4 inches. The Dexter Series Broadway with Round Rose Lever Lockset is available in dummy, passage, privacy, and keyed entry functions. Choose from any of the modern finish color options. The Schlage Broadway Lever with Round Rose has a sleek design that makes it an affordable and easy way to update the look and security of all your home's doors.

Features of the Schlage Broadway Lever with Round Rose:

  • Will fit door thicknesses from 1-3/8" to 1-3/4".
  • Universal latch fits either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backsets.
  • ANSI A156.2, 1996, Series 4000 Grade 3
  • Exposed trim is made out of wrought brass or bronze. Levers are zinc-based and plated to match the finish you choose.
  • Fits standard door preparations.
  • 5-Pin tumbler standard Schlage C keyway (for Keyed Entry function) .
  • Lifetime mechanical warranty.
  • 5 year finish warranty.

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: For use as a pull or to match trim. Does not latch and does not lock.
  • Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latches but does not lock.
  • Privacy (Bedroom or Bathroom): For doors that could need locking. A turn-button located in the middle of the lever locks the door while turning the inside lever unlocks it.
  • Keyed Entry (Keyed Lock): Use when a handle operated by a lock is needed. Unlocked by a key from the outside when locked by inside turn button. Inside locked and unlocked by turn-button.
